test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. B sits third to the left of T. R sits second to the left of S. Only T sits between A and R. C is not an immediate neighbour of B. How many people sit between D and R when counted from the right of D?
solution:
Given, A, B, C, D, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

R sits second to the left of S.

Only T sits between A and R.

B sits third to the left of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3357f085fbbdca000c0522aca43d17c625fe25bbe0379bd1a49a430ddb07fbb1.png] 

C is not an immediate neighbour of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6460b7812b31a5e6c1c374cfe8d91c57eb86ded4847dd285f1e11a51dadbd38f.png] 

And D sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a5b34ebe5897ce15bc89de386630792d50450bdeaa60553c2a3d49c916facab.png] 

Two people sit between D and R when counted from the right of D.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
